comments: a0d7c4f5: Initialize the Deficiency Tracking Report script and check for multiple divisions.
e0e695b7: If multiple divisions are enabled, prompt for division selection.
6a569145: If not using multiple divisions, automatically select the first division.
14dee6d6: Execute the selected report type logic.
a2229520: Prompt for the date range for the report.
f491aeee: Select the type(s) of deficiencies to include in the report.
b482214a: Prompt for additional report parameters.
59185a38: Notify the user that the report requires a wide format.
d75e20aa: Set up the report date to the current date.
a3367fcd: Prepare variables for report generation and call the device handler.
b873b918: Exit the script if setup is not completed successfully.
b4043d24: Begin the main report loop, checking each record.
290ba0f9: Branch to detailed report processing for types 1 and 3.
5c72aca2: Branch to summary report processing for type 2.
cbc61bb6: Display a message if no records are found matching the criteria.
43c20438: Exit the report script cleanly.
31da0e83: Subroutine to determine the service and specialty for a record.
58349935: Check if the record has an associated service; if not, quit.
c7b3bedb: Verify the service record exists; if not, set a flag to indicate a missing record.
1c1d35b4: Determine the ward associated with the service.
ea992790: Set the division based on the ward's associated division.
b08e3e20: Retrieve the division's DT record, if any.
db7b8c3d: Determine the service based on the ward, if not directly available.
8a9920f2: Fallback to default service if none is determined.
e870a2be: Determine the specialty, flagging if not within user-selected specialties.
7120bf4a: Exit the service and specialty determination subroutine.
ab1e46ba: Check if the record's division is selected by the user.
3b4276b3: Exclude records not matching the selected division.
6cbd2e5b: Skip processing for records from divisions not requiring review for 'SIGNED NO REVIEW'.
c8af8d7c: Skip processing for records from divisions requiring review only for 'REVIEWED'.
c3d11362: Skip processing for records marked as 'COMPLETED'.
f103b66b: Clear temporary variables.
4fa95cc0: Exclude records without a responsible physician if the report is filtered by physician.
c5945b5a: Exclude records with a responsible physician if the report is filtered by non-physician.
16eb8d53: Exclude records not matching selected deficiency types.
d1c90f6a: Exclude records outside the selected date range.
fe374bad: For physician reports, exclude records not matching selected physicians.
71900f58: For patient reports, exclude records not matching selected patients.
5e27c8ac: Exclude summary records if detailed records are requested.
7925b223: Initialize division totals.
445a7f97: Set up patient name and identifier for the report.
14e1f7d3: Format data for reporting by physician.
51f45ebc: Format data for reporting by patient.
37c41a38: Format service and specialty data for 'Service' report type.
c6f684ec: Set service variable for 'Service' report type selection.
6a543a6e: Set specialty variable for 'Specialty' report type selection.
6816afd1: Check for and handle query flag conditions.
76819843: Store 'Service' report type data.
4d179b34: Exit the check subroutine.
55d85e0d: Prompt for physician selection.
7f679d24: Exit the physician selection subroutine.
941c9c71: Prompt for patient selection.
67f1e7bc: Exit the patient selection subroutine.
a28d0375: Prompt for service selection.
d5756d9a: Prompt for specialty selection.
4c17556f: Exit the service and specialty selection subroutine.
